observed_behavior: Dispatch preparation attempted thread/resume and could fail when the Desktop retained the original worker's writer, although no implementation turn was requested.
expected_behavior: Preparing immutable instructions observes the original actor without competing with the transport that will execute them.
causal_mechanism: The preparation operation inherited private-dispatch writer acquisition. Its idle check occurred after resume, so another retained writer prevented preparation before the instruction claim.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A read-only preparation boundary acquires the exclusive capability owned by the independent execution transport.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Native writer exclusivity rejects resume even when the retained original worker is not executing an implementation turn.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Preparation and acknowledgement observe identity and exact turns without acquiring a writer; private execution acquires its writer explicitly.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Preparation reads original identity, latest terminal turn and activity, rejects observed active/system-error actors, validates the session marker and claims frozen instructions. Private dispatch alone resumes before preparation; acknowledgement matches original dispatch, generation, latest turn and exact user input.

applicability_conditions: An external transport retains the original native worker writer
Instruction preparation is separate from implementation dispatch
known_non_matches: An observed active worker remains ineligible for preparation
Private dispatch still requires native writer acquisition
confirmation_evidence: The protocol fixture rejects thread/resume as already having an active writer while the original preparation/acknowledgement Arc succeeds without that resume
An active original actor fails preparation before any dispatch claim is persisted
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-campaign-store.integration.test.ts: worker provisioning fences creation and atomically attaches the native identity and ignored marker
